[RARC.5.3.3] An expression that reads a **pattern position the
match never bound** is an unrecoverable fault: the engine
must halt the tier ([LERR.1.4.7]).

It is **not** an absent value. Nothing is missing — the
artefact is asking about a position the network does not
have, so the shape the rule set declared at load and the
shape the network is running disagree. Answering `null`
would report "unknown" for a rule set that cannot be run
as written, and would let the disagreement propagate as
data.

The engine does not repair it, because it cannot: which
position the author meant is not recoverable from the
artefact that got it wrong.
